title.narrative: ;In 2024, UNICEF supported routine vaccination of over 525,000 children <1 year. The "Big Catch-up" campaign reached 235,903 zero-dose children, while polio campaign targeted 3,942,720 children, achieving 97.4 per cent. Despite the challenges of weak healthcare systems, UNICEF prepared for new vaccine introductions and addressed gender/demand barriers, ensuring community-responsive services.;
